title: sdks: unify auth/retries & streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity fixes; v1.131.0
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: SDK parity drift has caused subtle differences in auth/retry behavior and streaming ergonomics between the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. This PR consolidates the auth + retry machinery, improves streaming client ergonomics (cancellation/auto-reconnect/backpressure), and applies parity fixes and small API ergonomic tweaks. It also bumps package versions to v1.131.0 to prepare for a coordinated release.

What I changed: consolidated a common auth/retry core that: retries on transient 401/429/503 with exponential backoff, preserves idempotency hints, and exposes a configurable RetryPolicy object across all SDKs; standardized token refresh hooks and added a minimal jitter strategy. Streaming ergonomics: added CancelableStream client abstraction (Python/TS/Go) that supports graceful cancel(), context-based cancellation, and automatic reconnect for transient network errors with configurable max-retries. Parity fixes: aligned error types/messages, unified method names for streaming.iter_messages / stream.receive, and fixed a mismatch in embedding client config between TS and Python. Version bump: package.json / setup.cfg updates and changelogs updated.

Testing: unit tests added for retry logic and streaming cancelation in all three SDKs; integration tests against the local mock server for auth flows; e2e smoke tests for streaming with simulated network flaps. CI: all SDK pipelines passed (lint, unit, integration).

Checklist:
- [x] Consolidate retry/auth core across SDKs
- [x] Implement CancelableStream with cancel()/context support
- [x] Add integration tests for token refresh and streaming reconnects
- [x] Update changelogs and bump versions to v1.131.0
- [x] Get approvals from SDK leads and QA

Rollout notes: will ship on coordinated release window. Consumers using custom retry logic should be advised to opt into the new RetryPolicy or pin to previous minor; migration notes added to the changelog.

Related: ENG-8932 (parity cleanup), ENG-9021 (streaming reconnection), SUP-421 (customer-reported streaming cancelation), previous sdks parity PRs in the v1.12x series.
